decisions.reason: The multi-model plug-in line builds on the established offer, has its own page and carries sunk development across several models, so management will stay committed to it.
The authentication and delegation service sits close to the core identity offering the firm has announced, so dropping it would contradict earlier decisions despite its low visibility.
The open GIS framework is a multi-model line with heavy sunk investment and is central to the firm's open, extensible strategy, so persistence is very likely.
The identity service was publicly launched as enabling seamless GeoIT integration and fits the enterprise-integration direction, so its visible commitment favors keeping it.
The consulting workshop was launched only in 2024 with its own page and builds on established consulting know-how, so any weak early results can be attributed to start-up effects.
